Tsareena

Grass

Alola · Generation 7

Tsareena is a Grass-type Fruit Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 21.4 kg. It evolves from Steenee. Its highest base stat is Attack (120), with a base stat total of 510.
